scope: every request that carried the field at SOURCE, whatever the model
reason: Briglia no longer sends the Fireworks/Kimi-only reasoning_history flag. Measured 2026-09-10 on OpenCode Go (kimi-k2.6, glm-5.3-flash, qwen3.8-max, deepseek-flash): identical behaviour, reasoning visibility and billing with or without it; the backends serving Kimi K3 (since 2026-09-01) and GLM ("Console Go", since 2026-09-10) reject requests that carry it with HTTP 400. Reasoning replay (reasoning_content on assistant messages) is unchanged.
source_change: OpenRouterRequest, ProviderExecutionContext and the archive summariser request no longer have the field (wip/drop-reasoning-history)
requests_without_the_field: requests that never carried it at SOURCE (kimi-k3, custom-model, local-model and OpenRouter wire fixtures; the lifecycle setup probe probe-0 and user-context call user-context-0) pass through unchanged and are still compared byte for byte
